_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The test seeds a 12-turn conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} whose first two user messages have data-message-id {{FIRST}} and {{SECOND}}; the URL fragments that link to them are {{FIRST_FRAGMENT}} and {{SECOND_FRAGMENT}}. window.fragmentScrolls lists the data-message-id of every element scrolled into view so far, in order; check it with an eval of JSON.stringify(window.fragmentScrolls). Call "append" sends another message and waits for its reply; after it, {{APPENDED}} is the reply's data-message-id. To "set the fragment to X", eval a promise that sets location.hash to X and resolves on the next hashchange event. "At the bottom" means the messages container (".messages-container") has scrollHeight - clientHeight - scrollTop below 5 and the scroll-to-bottom button (".scroll-to-bottom-button") is hidden. To "delay" a message, rename its data-message-id attribute to data-delayed-message-id, as if its element had not mounted yet; to "mount" it, set data-message-id back from data-delayed-message-id (leaving the other attribute). Perform the steps in order. The scroll-to-bottom button clears the current fragment. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the table of contents button (".toc-button") to be visible. 2. It should be at the bottom. 3. Release the bottom pin as an upward wheel gesture would: dispatch a synthetic WheelEvent("wheel", {deltaY: -10000, bubbles: true}) on the messages container, then set its scrollTop to 0. 4. Wait until its scrollTop is 0. 5. The scroll-to-bottom button (".scroll-to-bottom-button") should become visible. 6. Only now, with the scroll done, set the fragment without navigating: eval history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname + "#current"), and check that location.hash is "#current". 7. Click the scroll-to-bottom button. 8. location.hash should become "" and the scroll-to-bottom button should be hidden.

steps.expression: (function(){ var mc = document.querySelector('.messages-container'); mc.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', {deltaY: -10000, bubbles: true})); mc.scrollTop = 0; return mc.scrollTop; })()
